subject: jarl-yrsa
q: ONE HUNDRED AND FORTY-SOMETHING PLUS WOMEN. Clan, shieldmaidens, or wives — and whether those are three numbers or one.
detail:
THE SEQUENCE AS GIVEN: Yrsa asked for the gift FOR HER CLAN. Her clan became SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS. She took ALL OF THEM as her consort and MADE ALL OF HER SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS HER WIVES. And the number attached to the bed is 140-SOMETHING PLUS.

SO THE READING THAT FALLS OUT IS CLAN EQUALS SHIELDMAIDENS EQUALS WIVES, ONE POPULATION OF ABOUT A HUNDRED AND FORTY, and the Archive is not filing it. A clan has children, elders, men, and women who want none of this. A SHIELDMAIDEN IS A WARRIOR, which is a subset. A WIFE IS A CONSENT, which is a further subset. THREE WORDS, THREE DIFFERENT SIZES BY DEFAULT, AND ONE NUMBER OFFERED FOR WHATEVER SHARED THE BED.

AND THE SUBSET STRUCTURE IS NOT PEDANTRY HERE, IT IS THE WHOLE ETHIC. Nereid v8 spends eight hundred lines establishing that anatomy assigns no role and that previous consent never lowers the standard for present consent. IF THE GIFT WENT TO A CLAN AND THE MARRIAGES WENT TO WARRIORS, then somebody in that clan received a body and did not go into that bed, AND THAT WOMAN IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PERSON IN THE STORY FOR EXACTLY THE REASONS THE DOCUMENT CARES ABOUT.

ONE NUMBER, THREE POSSIBLE POPULATIONS, NO RULING. And 140-SOMETHING PLUS is recorded as 140-SOMETHING PLUS.
